title: After the nightly capture, new Inventory Value snapshot rows carry untracked while older rows keep tracked
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. API replay from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location (Copy as fetch from a request of the logged-in session, then edit method, path and body). Runs over two days. QAPL-T5 is tracked with stock and the nightly capture has already run at least once since release (an As-of date before today has saved figures for it). No DB access: each snapshot row's is_tracked flag is read through the report, which for past dates uses each saved row's own flag. After the test turn QAPL-T5's tracking back on.
custom_steps:
1. Day 1: Reports > Inventory Value, set As-of to yesterday; note QAPL-T5's quantity and Total Cost. Replay GET /api/reporting/reports/inventory-value for that date.
  2. Day 1: open QAPL-T5 on /parts/inventory, switch Track quantities and cost of goods off and Save.
  3. Day 2, after the nightly capture: run the report with As-of = the first date captured after the change and replay the API call for it.
  4. Day 2: run the report with As-of = the date used in step 1 and replay the API call for it.
  5. Day 2: run the report for today.
custom_expected:
1. QAPL-T5 is listed on screen and in the 200 response with the same quantity and Total Cost.
  2. Saved; QAPL-T5's Total Qty reads Not Tracked.
  3. QAPL-T5 is absent on screen and in the response: the new snapshot row carries untracked (no DB access: this stands in for the DB check of is_tracked = 0 on the new row).
  4. QAPL-T5 is still listed with the same quantity and Total Cost as in step 1: the older row keeps tracked and its saved figures (no DB access: this stands in for the DB check of is_tracked = 1, qty and total_cost on the older row).
  5. QAPL-T5 is absent from today's report.
